name: Cloak of Flames: Immolation adds its spell power bonus once (#12311)
contract: #12311: Cloak of Flames 3475 equips damage shield 909276 Immolation, tooltip ${$m1+0.035*$SP+0.023*$AP} (base 30). AuraEffect::CalculateAmount adds the caster bonus to a SPELL_AURA_DAMAGE_SHIELD amount when the aura is applied, and Unit::DealDamageShieldDamage adds it again on every hit, so a cloak equipped while carrying spell power dealt about 30 + 0.07 * SP. aura_ascension_damage_shield_single_bonus keeps the stored amount at its base 30. The warrior carries 1000 fixture spell power before equipping the cloak: once gives about 30 + 35 + 0.023 * AP (~70), doubled about 110.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
The stored shield amount stays at its base 30
The last damage shield hit is Immolation
Immolation adds 3.5% SP once (~70), not twice (~110)
